highlights: Fast mode is off for each Claude agent after this update: if you used it, turn it on again in the model picker.
Add a server on your own Linux computer or VPS with one command, or ask an agent to install it there over SSH.
Server settings → Transfer now moves the chat history, the channels and the workflows to the new server.
On a joined server, the desktop app and the browser app now have most of the features of this computer.
The Apps catalog has 207 new apps, such as monday.com, Miro, Dropbox and Zapier, with a browser sign-in.
